responsibility: Adapts the Moxie target for uClinux-style ELF-to-FLT linking and C library behavior. It overrides startup-file and link specs for the flat-binary environment, installs GNU user OS builtins, marks missing C99 libc functionality via TARGET_LIBC_HAS_FUNCTION, and customizes mudflap wrapping for the always-static uClinux link model, serving as the Linux-family OS configuration layer on top of the base Moxie port.
